newsitem.title: UK: Bradford wool tops prices suffocated by sterling.
newsitem.headline: Bradford wool tops prices suffocated by sterling.

text.p: Topmakers at the Bradford wool market saw prices forced down by a stronger pound, trade sources reported on Monday.
Sterling has spent the end of December at around 2.6 against the mark. Prices for all but pure English types were down by an average of four pence per kg with 70s Super losing seven pence per kg.

With what one source described as "virtually no trading interest" and no significant news seen from primary markets, prices are expected to remain chained to currency until production resumes in the first week of January.
